name: Keelcover
summary: A marine insurance broker portal where every placement sails a route you can watch
about: Keelcover is a broker portal for a made-up firm that places cover for ferries, fishing fleets, marinas, boatyards and cargo. Each placement is a ship on a hand-drawn sea chart, sailing port by port from enquiry to issued policy as surveys finish and quotes arrive. It also covers clients, policies and renewals, claims, insurer appetite, a calendar and commission.
how: Watch ships sail along the route as surveys come back and insurers quote
Drag a ship to another port to move the placement, or focus it and press M
Open a placement to compare market quotes, choose a lead insurer and bind
Start a renewal from a policy and see it set sail from Enquiry Point
Drag a claim from notified to settled as the adjusters work
Drag a survey or meeting to another day on the calendar
